summary: Per-frame force propagation over the vehicle physics node. Runs SweptSuspensionCollisionDetection then VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation, applies TireForceSolver per strut, propagates tire and grip forces along each strut's linked node chain (+268) with distance-based falloff into +136/+140, computes a maximum propagated force into this+0x148, then applies a grip-multiplier pass (sub_4FB260) and a per-strut finalization pass (sub_4FAF60). All loops iterate this+0x130 struts over the array base this+0x134 with stride 316. Called by CollisionWrapperWithLock (004E4910).

local_names.a1: vehicle physics node carrying the strut array
local_names.a2: propagated force accumulator carried across chain links
local_names.i: current chain node during the tire-force walk
local_names.j: current chain node during the grip-force walk
local_names.k: current chain node during the max-force walk

operations.description: First stage: SweptSuspensionCollisionDetection(a1, a2, a3) advances struts and resolves swept contacts
VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation(a1, 0) runs the full-grid suspension solver across all struts
Every loop in the function is gated on the strut count this+0x130 being greater than 0 (packet guard)
Per-strut loop over the array base this+0x134 with byte stride 316: TireForceSolver on the strut contact state (+112/+116/+120) and stores the resulting force at strut+136
Tire-force propagation: follows the linked chain from strut+268 while each link points back at the current node (link+272 == strut), applying TireForce per link

Distance falloff: distance between the strut center (+148/+152/+156) and the link feature (+148/+152/+156 relative to the link), then attenuation a2 = a2 * (distance / i[34]) * 0.5 + i[34]; the attenuated force is written to link+136 and the walk continues while it stays positive and below the link's stored force
Copy pass: for each strut, store strut+136 into strut+140
Grip-force propagation: walks the same linked chain with TireGripLateralForceCalculation, applying the same distance-falloff attenuation and writing the result to link+140
Initialization pass: each strut's +144 slot is set to the literal -1082130432 (bit pattern for -1.0f)

Maximum-force accumulation: this+0x148 is reset to 0.0, then for each chain link a candidate force at link+144 is computed (falloff-scaled or travel-scaled depending on the strut+72 versus link+18 comparison) and this+0x148 is raised when the link force exceeds it and the link's +300 guard is clear
Grip-multiplier pass: sub_4FB260(v53) called once per strut with the computed multiplier
Finalization pass: sub_4FAF60(strut base) called once per strut
Returns the strut count (this+0x130); the function is invoked by CollisionWrapperWithLock (004E4910)

clean_pseudocode: grip walk with TireGripLateralForceCalculation, writing link+140;
max-walk: this[0x148/4] = 0.0; update to largest link+144 while guard clean;
